remarks: Welcome to Unit 841 at the Fountain Terrace community. This two-bedroom, one-bathroom end unit offers approximately 875 square feet of comfortable living space with a functional and inviting layout. The home features two spacious bedrooms, an eat-in kitchen, and a bright living area filled with natural light. Step out onto your private balcony and enjoy impressive views overlooking Downtown Stamford. Fountain Terrace offers a variety of amenities for residents, including on-site laundry facilities, a fitness center, and a swimming pool. The community also includes a playground, a community room for gatherings, and a gated entry with 24-hour security. Unit 841 includes one assigned parking space with additional parking available. Common Charge includes heat, hot water, cooking gas, water, sewer, property management, and pool service. Conveniently located near the Tully Center, public transportation, Metro North train and many restaurants. Schedule your showing and discover all this home has to offer! Downtown living at it's best.
